headline: I build agents with spending limits built in, and I've shipped lending on mobile money at scale.
pitch: At DGRS Labs I architected loom, the agent platform behind CoNexus: six agents in production, a cost on every step, budgets that block, downgrade or notify when a run overspends, and hooks that can stop a step before it runs. At Equity I led the team that took a USSD loan service with mobile money integrations, including M-Pesa, to production on a platform serving 16 million customers. I write code with Claude and Codex every day.

matches.requirement: Enable payments for consumers and businesses
matches.evidence: Led a team of four delivering a USSD loan service on a platform serving 16 million customers and handling over 1 million loan requests a month, with mobile money integrations including M-Pesa, through rollouts across six countries.

matches.requirement: Agents that act on behalf of humans
matches.evidence: Architected loom, now Noewright, which runs six specialized agents in production for CoNexus. Agents run asynchronously and connect to external tools through plugins; every step is priced, budgets cap spend per key or session, and hooks can skip or retry a step.

matches.requirement: Code using agents, and use them personally
matches.evidence: Introduced a Claude and Codex generator–reviewer workflow with production-like Docker test environments that catches defects before deployment, and GitHub Actions pipelines that cut deployment time by 80%.

matches.requirement: Build products from 0 to 1 and own big parts of them
matches.evidence: Built loom, buckt and CoNexus's in-house model service on open-source models, which cut operating costs by 30%, while leading a team of three and owning architecture through production delivery.

matches.requirement: AWS, shell scripting and running production
matches.evidence: Run DGRS Labs' infrastructure single-handedly, with scripts that restore the full stack automatically. Migrated the platform's media to Cloudflare R2, which speaks the S3 API, across three environments with no downtime.

resume.summary: Lead software engineer with 5+ years building and running production systems in fintech and AI. Architected loom, an agent orchestration platform that runs six specialized agents in production, with per-step costs, budgets and hooks, and builds with Claude and Codex in an AI-assisted generator–reviewer workflow. Previously led delivery of a USSD loan service with mobile money integrations on a financial platform serving 16 million customers in six countries.

note:
Agents that buy things for people is where my two backgrounds meet. At Equity I led the team that took a USSD loan service to production across six countries, with mobile money, including M-Pesa, on the other end of every loan. At DGRS Labs I built loom, the agent platform behind CoNexus, and gave it a cost on every step, budgets that block or downgrade a run, and hooks that can stop a step before it runs.

I already work the way you describe. Claude and Codex write and review my code under a generator–reviewer workflow, and I write Claude Code skills for work I repeat, including the one that drafted this page from your job post.

What would be new: card issuing and card networks, Node.js as a main backend (most of my backend work is in Go and Python), and AWS beyond S3. I'd rather say that plainly. I'm in Lagos and would relocate to San Francisco with your sponsorship.
